title: reflowR: Themed Extensions for Workflowr Research Workflows — reflowR-package
text: Extends workflowr package themed color schemes, structured analysis pipeline templates, utility scripts reproducible research. Wraps workflowr::wflow_start() adds five color schemes (clinical, basic research, code/statistics, special, neutral), three depth presets Rmd pipeline (minimal, standard, extended), custom CSS/SCSS theming, SVG icons, ggplot2 theme functions, Quarto report template. generated projects remain fully compatible standard workflowr commands.

title: Initialize a Themed Workflowr Project — reflow_init
code: reflow_init(   directory,   name = NULL,   author = "Author Name",   email = NULL,   affiliation = NULL,   orcid = NULL,   website = NULL,   scheme = c("basic", "clinical", "code", "special", "other"),   depth = c("standard", "minimal", "extended"),   seed = as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")),   github_url = NULL,   existing = FALSE,   git = TRUE,   change_wd = rlang::is_interactive(),   user.name = NULL,   user.email = NULL,   open = rlang::is_interactive() )

title: Initialize a Themed Workflowr Project — reflow_init
text: directory Character. Path project created. Passed directly workflowr::wflow_start(). name Character. Project name (used titles navbar). NULL, derived directory basename. author Character. Full name primary author. email Character. Author's email address (optional). affiliation Character. Author's institutional affiliation (optional). orcid Character. Author's ORCID iD (optional, format: "0000-0000-0000-0000"). website Character. URL author's project website (optional). scheme Character. Color scheme apply. One "clinical", "basic", "code", "special", "". Defaults "basic". depth Character. Rmd pipeline depth. One "minimal", "standard", "extended". Defaults "standard". seed Integer. Random seed workflowr reproducibility. Defaults .integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")). github_url Character. GitHub repository URL (optional). Adds GitHub link navbar. existing Logical. directory existing project? Passed workflowr::wflow_start(existing = ...). Default FALSE. git Logical. Initialize git repository make first commit? Default TRUE. change_wd Logical. Change working directory new project? Default TRUE interactive sessions. user.name Character. Git user name (optional). Passed workflowr::wflow_start(). user.email Character. Git user email (optional). Passed workflowr::wflow_start(). open Logical. Open project RStudio creation? Default TRUE interactive sessions.

title: Initialize a Themed Workflowr Project — reflow_init
text: Invisibly returns path created project directory.

title: Initialize a Themed Workflowr Project — reflow_init
text: function proceeds two phases: Phase 1 – workflowr base: Calls workflowr::wflow_start() git = FALSE create standard workflowr scaffold without committing yet. Phase 2 – reflowR theming: Replaces _site.yml, index.Rmd, .Rmd themed versions; adds analysis pipeline Rmd files, CSS/SCSS, icon, setup script, utility script, Quarto report template, additional subdirectories. git = TRUE, initializes git commits files.

title: reflowR 0.1.0
text: Initial release. reflow_init() – main function wrapping workflowr::wflow_start() theming. Five color schemes: clinical (red), basic (steelblue), code (forest green), special (purple), (grey). Three depth presets: minimal (3 steps), standard (8 steps), extended (12 steps). Custom SVG icons per scheme embedded navbar. CSS/SCSS theme generation color scheme definitions. reflow_preview() interactive color preview. reflow_schemes() reflow_presets() convenience functions. Full compatibility workflowr commands (wflow_build, wflow_publish, etc.). Two vignettes: Getting Started Color Schemes Reference.
